name: smwmusic-rat-attack-title-screen
title: Rat Attack! - Title Screen
description:
The title theme from the PS1, N64 and PC hidden gem, Rat Attack! (the PS1 version is thankfully re-released on GOG). Starring the Scratch Cats (not to be confused with you know, the programming language you definitely used at school if you're a Gen Z), the goal of the game is to eliminate you know... rats that appear on screen, using a rectangular lasso (functioning almost similar to the arcade games Libble Rabble and Qix).

Not compatible with Blargg/Thunder and Bonus End!

Good for not only title screens, but also overworlds and mid-level bonus levels.

2026-01-08: Updated with more noticeable echo, and the speed now matches the original more closely (the internal song tempo was also doubled, for less staccato).
